learning_outcomes.text: Students know the basic concepts and methods of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning and can independently apply them to technical and business problems.
They understand the advantages and disadvantages of various algorithms as well as their possible applications and limitations in practical applications.
Students are able to use relevant Python libraries to solve specific problems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
Overview of the most important Machine Learning algorithms and methods (e.g., linear regression, decision trees, neural networks, clustering methods)
Application areas of AI in mechanical and industrial engineering
Implementation and adaptation of Machine Learning models in Python
Introduction to relevant Python libraries (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow)
Training, evaluation and optimization of models
Ethics and responsibility in dealing with Artificial Intelligence
assessment_rules: To receive credit points, the module exam must be passed. The grade's weight for the final grade is determined by the credit points.
bibliography: Trevor Hastie, Robert Tibshirani, Jerome Friedmann: The Elements of Statistical Learning: Data Mining, Inference, and Prediction . Springer series in statistics, second edition. Springer 2009.
